verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֙יִת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וּבַ֖יִת לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·lō·mōh liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·yiṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh ū·ḇa·yiṯ lə·mal·ḵū·ṯōw
verses.literal: Now Solomon purposed to build a house for the Name of the LORD and a royal palace for himself
verses.literalPt: Resolveu Salomão edificar uma casa ao nome de Jeová e uma casa para o seu reino.

verses.original: וַיִּסְפֹּ֨ר שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אִ֣ישׁ סַבָּ֔ל וּשְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ חֹצֵ֣ב בָּהָ֑ר וּמְנַצְּחִ֣ים עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yis·pōr šə·lō·mōh šiḇ·‘îm ’e·lep̄ ’îš sab·bāl ū·šə·mō·w·nîm ’e·lep̄ ’îš ḥō·ṣêḇ bā·hār ū·mə·naṣ·ṣə·ḥîm ‘ă·lê·hem šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: So he conscripted . . . 70,000 . . . . . . porters 80,000 . . . . . . stonecutters in the mountains and 3,600 . . . . . . . . . supervisors . . .
verses.literalPt: Contou Salomão setenta mil homens para servirem de carregadores, oitenta mil, para cortarem pedras nos montes e três mil e seiscentos, para serem inspetores sobre eles.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶל־ חוּרָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ עִם־ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י וַתִּֽשְׁלַֽח־ ל֣וֹ אֲרָזִ֔ים לִבְנֽוֹת־ ל֥וֹ בַ֖יִת לָשֶׁ֥בֶת בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ šə·lō·mōh ’el- ḥū·rām me·leḵ- ṣōr lê·mōr ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘im- dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî wat·tiš·laḥ- lōw ’ă·rā·zîm liḇ·nō·wṯ- lōw ḇa·yiṯ lā·še·ḇeṯ bōw
verses.literal: Then Solomon sent word to Hiram king of Tyre . . . Do for me as you did for my father David when you sent him cedars to build himself a house to live in
verses.literalPt: Salomão mandou dizer a Hirão, rei de Tiro: Do mesmo modo que fizeste com Davi, meu pai, e lhe enviaste cedros para lhe edificar uma casa em que morasse, assim também faze comigo.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י בֽוֹנֶה־ בַּ֜יִת לְשֵׁ֣ם׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֗י לְהַקְדִּ֣ישׁ ל֡וֹ לְהַקְטִ֣יר לְפָנָ֣יו קְטֹֽרֶת־ סַמִּים֩ וּמַעֲרֶ֨כֶת תָּמִ֤יד וְעֹלוֹת֙ לַבֹּ֣קֶר וְלָעֶ֔רֶב לַשַּׁבָּתוֹת֙ וְלֶ֣חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וּֽלְמוֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֖ם זֹ֥את עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ă·nî ḇō·w·neh- ba·yiṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy lə·haq·dîš lōw lə·haq·ṭîr lə·p̄ā·nāw qə·ṭō·reṯ- sam·mîm ū·ma·‘ă·re·ḵeṯ tā·mîḏ wə·‘ō·lō·wṯ lab·bō·qer wə·lā·‘e·reḇ laš·šab·bā·ṯō·wṯ wə·le·ḥo·ḏā·šîm ū·lə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lə·‘ō·w·lām zōṯ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Behold I am about to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God to dedicate to Him for burning fragrant incense before Him for displaying the showbread continuously and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening as well as on the Sabbaths New Moons and appointed feasts of the LORD our God This is ordained for Israel forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu estou para edificar uma casa ao nome de Jeová, meu Deus, para lha dedicar, para queimar diante dele incenso aromático, para que não faltem os pães da proposição, e para os holocaustos da manhã e da tarde, nos sábados, nas luas novas e nas festas fixas de Jeová, nosso Deus. Para Israel é isso obrigação perpétua.

verses.original: וְהַבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֑וֹל כִּֽי־ גָד֥וֹל אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ מִכָּל־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî ḇō·w·neh gā·ḏō·wl kî- ḡā·ḏō·wl ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū mik·kāl hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: The house that I am building will be great for our God is greater than all gods
verses.literalPt: A casa que eu estou para edificar deve ser grande, porque o nosso Deus é grande sobre todos os deuses.

verses.original: וּמִ֤י יַעֲצָר־ כֹּ֙חַ֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֧י הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וּשְׁמֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּלֻ֑הוּ וּמִ֤י אֲנִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶבְנֶה־ לּ֣וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֖י אִם־ לְהַקְטִ֥יר לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mî ya·‘ă·ṣār- kō·aḥ liḇ·nō·wṯ- lōw ḇa·yiṯ kî haš·šā·ma·yim ū·šə·mê haš·šā·ma·yim lō yə·ḵal·kə·lu·hū ū·mî ’ă·nî ’ă·šer ’eḇ·neh- lōw ḇa·yiṯ kî ’im- lə·haq·ṭîr lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: But who is able . . . to build a house for Him since the heavens even the highest heavens . . . cannot contain Him Who then am I that I should build a house for Him except as a place . . . to burn sacrifices before Him
verses.literalPt: Mas quem é capaz de lhe edificar uma casa, visto que o céu e o céu dos céus o não podem conter? Quem sou eu para lhe edificar uma casa, a não ser para se queimar incenso perante ele?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה שְֽׁלַֽח־ לִ֣י אִישׁ־ חָכָ֡ם לַעֲשׂוֹת֩ בַּזָּהָ֨ב וּבַכֶּ֜סֶף וּבַנְּחֹ֣שֶׁת וּבַבַּרְזֶ֗ל וּבָֽאַרְגְּוָן֙ וְכַרְמִ֣יל וּתְכֵ֔לֶת וְיֹדֵ֖עַ לְפַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתּוּחִ֑ים עִם־ הַֽחֲכָמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עִמִּי֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֣ה וּבִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵכִ֖ין דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·laḥ- lî ’îš- ḥā·ḵām la·‘ă·śō·wṯ baz·zā·hāḇ ū·ḇak·ke·sep̄ ū·ḇan·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇab·bar·zel ū·ḇā·’ar·gə·wān wə·ḵar·mîl ū·ṯə·ḵê·leṯ wə·yō·ḏê·a‘ lə·p̄at·tê·aḥ pit·tū·ḥîm ‘im- ha·ḥă·ḵā·mîm ’ă·šer ‘im·mî bî·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer hê·ḵîn dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: Send me therefore a craftsman . . . skilled in engraving . . . to work with gold and silver with bronze and iron and with purple crimson and blue yarn He will work with my craftsmen - in Judah and Jerusalem whom my father David provided
verses.literalPt: Agora, envia-me um homem que saiba trabalhar em ouro, em prata, em bronze, em ferro, em púrpura, em carmesim e em azul e que saiba fazer toda sorte de obra de entalhe, com os peritos que estão comigo na Judeia e em Jerusalém, os quais Davi, meu pai, escolheu.

verses.original: וּֽשְׁלַֽח־ לִי֩ עֲצֵ֨י אֲרָזִ֜ים בְּרוֹשִׁ֣ים וְאַלְגּוּמִּים֮ מֵֽהַלְּבָנוֹן֒ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ יֽוֹדְעִ֔ים לִכְר֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן וְהִנֵּ֥ה עֲבָדַ֖י עִם־ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·laḥ- lî ‘ă·ṣê ’ă·rā·zîm bə·rō·wō·šîm wə·’al·gūm·mîm mê·hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn kî ’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’ă·šer ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā yō·wḏ·‘îm liḵ·rō·wṯ ‘ă·ṣê lə·ḇā·nō·wn wə·hin·nêh ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay ‘im- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Send me also cedar cypress and algum logs from Lebanon for I know that your servants have skill to cut timber there And indeed my servants will work with yours
verses.literalPt: Manda-me também do Líbano madeiras de cedro, de cipreste e de ébano, porque sei que os teus servos são destros em cortar madeiras no Líbano. Eis que os meus servos estarão com os teus,

verses.original: וּלְהָכִ֥ין לִ֛י עֵצִ֖ים לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֥וֹל וְהַפְלֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·hā·ḵîn lî ‘ê·ṣîm lā·rōḇ kî hab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî ḇō·w·neh gā·ḏō·wl wə·hap̄·lê
verses.literal: to prepare for me timber in abundance because the temple I am building will be great and wonderful
verses.literalPt: para me prepararem madeiras em abundância, porque a casa que eu estou para edificar será grande e maravilhosa.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה לַֽחֹטְבִ֣ים׀ לְֽכֹרְתֵ֣י׀ הָעֵצִ֡ים נָתַתִּי֩ חִטִּ֨ים׀ מַכּ֜וֹת לַעֲבָדֶ֗יךָ כֹּרִים֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׂעֹרִ֕ים כֹּרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְיַ֗יִן בַּתִּים֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְשֶׁ֕מֶן בַּתִּ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh la·ḥō·ṭə·ḇîm lə·ḵō·rə·ṯê hā·‘ê·ṣîm nā·ṯat·tî ḥiṭ·ṭîm mak·kō·wṯ la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā kō·rîm ‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ū·śə·‘ō·rîm kō·rîm ‘eś·rîm ’ā·lep̄ wə·ya·yin bat·tîm ‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ wə·še·men bat·tîm ‘eś·rîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: I will pay your servants the woodcutters . . . . . . 20,000 . . . cors of ground wheat 20,000 . . . cors of barley 20,000 . . . baths of wine and 20,000 . . . baths of olive oil
verses.literalPt: Darei aos teus servos que cortarem madeiras vinte mil coros de trigo batido, vinte mil coros de cevada, vinte mil batos de vinho e vinte mil batos de azeite.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר חוּרָ֤ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹר֙ בִּכְתָ֔ב וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּאַהֲבַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ נְתָנְךָ֥ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥū·rām me·leḵ- ṣōr biḵ·ṯāḇ way·yiš·laḥ ’el- šə·lō·mōh bə·’a·hă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ‘am·mōw nə·ṯā·nə·ḵā ‘ă·lê·hem me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then Hiram king of Tyre wrote a letter in reply to Solomon Because the LORD loves His people He has set you over them as king
verses.literalPt: Hirão, rei de Tiro, respondeu numa carta que enviou a Salomão: Porque Jeová ama ao seu povo, te constituiu rei sobre ele.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ חוּרָם֒ בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַן֩ לְדָוִ֨יד הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ בֵּ֣ן חָכָ֗ם יוֹדֵ֙עַ֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְנֶה־ בַּ֙יִת֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וּבַ֖יִת לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥū·rām bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯan lə·ḏā·wîḏ ham·me·leḵ bên ḥā·ḵām yō·w·ḏê·a‘ śê·ḵel ū·ḇî·nāh ’ă·šer yiḇ·neh- ba·yiṯ Yah·weh ū·ḇa·yiṯ lə·mal·ḵū·ṯōw
verses.literal: And Hiram added Blessed be the LORD the God of Israel who made the heavens and the earth He has given King David a wise . . . son with insight and understanding who will build a temple for the LORD and a royal palace for himself
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Hirão: Bendito seja Jeová, Deus de Israel, que fez o céu e a terra, que deu ao rei Davi um filho sábio, dotado de discrição e de entendimento, o qual edificasse uma casa a Jeová e uma casa para o seu reino!

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה שָׁלַ֧חְתִּי אִישׁ־ חָכָ֛ם יוֹדֵ֥עַ בִּינָ֖ה לְחוּרָ֥ם אָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šā·laḥ·tî ’îš- ḥā·ḵām yō·w·ḏê·a‘ bî·nāh lə·ḥū·rām ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: So now I am sending you Huram-abi . . . a skillful man endowed with creativity
verses.literalPt: Eu te envio um homem perito, dotado de entendimento, Hirão-Abi,

verses.original: בֶּן־ אִשָּׁ֞ה מִן־ בְּנ֣וֹת דָּ֗ן וְאָבִ֣יו אִישׁ־ צֹרִ֡י יוֹדֵ֡עַ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת בַּזָּֽהָב־ וּ֠בַכֶּסֶף בַּנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת בַּבַּרְזֶ֜ל בָּאֲבָנִ֣ים וּבָעֵצִ֗ים בָּאַרְגָּמָ֤ן בַּתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וּבַבּ֣וּץ וּבַכַּרְמִ֔יל וּלְפַתֵּ֙חַ֙ כָּל־ פִּתּ֔וּחַ וְלַחְשֹׁ֖ב כָּל־ מַחֲשָׁ֑בֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנָּֽתֶן־ לוֹ֙ עִם־ חֲכָמֶ֔יךָ וְֽחַכְמֵ֔י אֲדֹנִ֖י דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’iš·šāh min- bə·nō·wṯ dān wə·’ā·ḇîw ’îš- ṣō·rî yō·w·ḏê·a‘ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ baz·zā·hāḇ- ū·ḇak·ke·sep̄ ban·nə·ḥō·šeṯ bab·bar·zel bā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ū·ḇā·‘ê·ṣîm bā·’ar·gā·mān bat·tə·ḵê·leṯ ū·ḇab·būṣ ū·ḇak·kar·mîl ū·lə·p̄at·tê·aḥ kāl- pit·tū·aḥ wə·laḥ·šōḇ kāl- ma·ḥă·šā·ḇeṯ ’ă·šer yin·nā·ṯen- lōw ‘im- ḥă·ḵā·me·ḵā wə·ḥaḵ·mê ’ă·ḏō·nî dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā
verses.literal: He is the son of a woman from the daughters of Dan and his father is a man of Tyre He is skilled in work with gold and silver bronze and iron stone and wood purple blue and crimson yarn and fine linen He is experienced in every kind of engraving . . . and can execute any design that is given him He will work with your craftsmen and with those of my lord your father David
verses.literalPt: filho de uma mulher das filhas de Dã, cujo pai era de Tiro, que sabe trabalhar em ouro, em prata, em bronze, em ferro, em pedra, em madeira, em púrpura, em azul, em linho fino e em carmesim; que sabe também fazer toda sorte de obra de entalhe e idear qualquer coisa necessária; para que lhe seja designado um lugar juntamente com os teus peritos e com os peritos de teu pai Davi, meu senhor.

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּה הַחִטִּ֨ים וְהַשְּׂעֹרִ֜ים הַשֶּׁ֤מֶן וְהַיַּ֙יִן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנִ֔י יִשְׁלַ֖ח לַעֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ha·ḥiṭ·ṭîm wə·haś·śə·‘ō·rîm haš·še·men wə·hay·ya·yin ’ă·šer ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nî yiš·laḥ la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw
verses.literal: Now let my lord send to his servants the wheat barley olive oil and wine he promised
verses.literalPt: Agora, mande meu senhor aos seus servos o trigo, a cevada, o azeite e o vinho de que falou;

verses.original: וַ֠אֲנַחְנוּ נִכְרֹ֨ת עֵצִ֤ים מִן־ הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ כְּכָל־ צָרְכֶּ֔ךָ וּנְבִיאֵ֥ם לְךָ֛ רַפְסֹד֖וֹת עַל־ יָ֣ם יָפ֑וֹ וְאַתָּ֛ה תַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·naḥ·nū niḵ·rōṯ ‘ê·ṣîm min- hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn kə·ḵāl- ṣā·rə·ke·ḵā ū·nə·ḇî·’êm lə·ḵā rap̄·sō·ḏō·wṯ ‘al- yām yā·p̄ōw wə·’at·tāh ta·‘ă·leh ’ō·ṯām yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: We will cut logs from Lebanon as many as you need and we will float them to you as rafts by sea down to Joppa Then you can take them up to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: e nós cortaremos tanta madeira do Líbano quanta houveres mister e a traremos, em jangadas, pelo mar até Jope; e tu mandarás transportá-la para Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיִּסְפֹּ֣ר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה כָּל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הַגֵּירִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַחֲרֵ֣י הַסְּפָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְפָרָ֖ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמָּצְא֗וּ מֵאָ֤ה וַחֲמִשִּׁים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·pōr šə·lō·mōh kāl- hā·’ă·nā·šîm hag·gê·rîm ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl ’a·ḥă·rê has·sə·p̄ār ’ă·šer sə·p̄ā·rām dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇîw way·yim·mā·ṣə·’ū mê·’āh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Solomon numbered all the foreign men in the land of Israel following the census - his father David had conducted and there were found to be 153,600 in all . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Salomão mandou fazer uma resenha de todos os estrangeiros que havia na terra de Israel, depois da resenha que tinha mandado fazer seu pai Davi; e acharam-se cento e cinquenta e três mil e seiscentos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ מֵהֶ֜ם שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ סַבָּ֔ל וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֹצֵ֣ב בָּהָ֑ר וּשְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת מְנַצְּחִ֖ים לְהַעֲבִ֥יד אֶת־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś mê·hem šiḇ·‘îm ’e·lep̄ sab·bāl ū·šə·mō·nîm ’e·lep̄ ḥō·ṣêḇ bā·hār ū·šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·šêš mê·’ō·wṯ mə·naṣ·ṣə·ḥîm lə·ha·‘ă·ḇîḏ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Solomon made . . . 70,000 of them . . . porters 80,000 . . . stonecutters in the mountains and 3,600 . . . . . . . . . supervisors . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Destes escolheu setenta mil para servirem de carregadores, e oitenta mil, para cortarem pedras nos montes, e três mil e seiscentos, para fazerem trabalhar o povo.
